title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SimpleActionOperationInput
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SimpleActionOperationInput. This class indicates that the parameter needed by the action to operate is simple (i.e. integer, string, etc). Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SimpleActionOperationInput'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasActionValue.description: Property. It specifies the input of a method from the instance (COSEM object) of a class. The value of this property conforms to a simple type (not a structure); represented here as a string for interoperability across the various COSEM simple datatypes it may actually hold.
